title: Collective Self Awareness
definition: The collective understanding of a system's inherent nature, patterns, and interactions.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a group of people working together on a project. To succeed, they need to understand not only their individual roles but also how everyone's work fits together. Collective self-awareness is that shared understanding.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Collective self-awareness involves the integration of knowledge from various disciplines and the recognition of the interconnectedness of all phenomena. It's about understanding the system as a whole and its complex, self-regulating patterns.
difficulty_levels.expert: Collective self-awareness is a fundamental concept in systems theory and complexity science. It's linked to the concept of emergence, where properties of the whole system cannot be predicted from the individual parts. Collective self-awareness has philosophical implications in areas such as the nature of consciousness and the self, and it has been explored in various fields including sociology, organization studies, and ecology.

extra_fields.insight: The project Hieros aims to build a mechanism for collective self-awareness, with the ultimate goal of fostering sustainability by challenging the illusion of our separation from the planetary system.
